correctness.rationale: The pair-generated subquasigroup is uniquely the 3-point Steiner quasigroup, so ultrahomogeneity yields 2-transitivity. Thus every permutation preserves the two 2-orbits. The ordered distinct block triples form one automorphism orbit; a 3-closure permutation preserves that orbit and therefore the quasigroup multiplication. Standard closure monotonicity gives all k>=3.
